tbesh_html:
1) to rejoice, exult, be glad
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to rejoice
1a2) to tremble (from fear)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to spin round (under the influence of any violent emotion), i.e. usually rejoice, or (as cringing) fear
strongs_1890.derivation: or (by permutation) גּוּל; a primitive root;
strongs_1890.kjv_def: be glad, joy, be joyful, rejoice.
